items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: I can't even carry Hurt's horn. The kind of stuff he plays.

ctx.x: I was going to ask you, speaking of no rehearsals, remember when you played the Queen Anne room at the Montaléon?

Pick? I appreciated that job. It was one of the nicest jobs I ever played in my life. Orwin called me and said, hey Stuart, I've got a job, will you come in with me? He says, you have the tax numbers for reporting the tax and everything. I said, delighted. He says, I have a drummer. I said, well, okay. He says, can you get the men? I said, I can get the men that played last Saturday with Shark. I said, I've been giving them more work than Shark had. That time I was. He says, no, we can't use the two Christians.…
Yeah I think Pinky had something to do with it.
